description: Beat Breeze is a background-music platform for hotels, restaurants, cafes, and retail. Connect it to ChatGPT to manage the music in your venues just by asking: see what's playing in each zone, turn a zone up or down, switch playlists, temporarily play something for an event, or schedule a change for later. Every action respects the permissions of your signed-in Beat Breeze account: the assistant can only see and control the zones you're allowed to manage, scheduled changes require an explicit confirmation, and you can revoke the connection from your dashboard at any time. For existing Beat Breeze customers.

defaultPrompt: Show me what's playing in my venues.
Set the volume in my selected zone to 40%.
Play a Chillhop playlist for 30 minutes, then return to the schedule.
